in_marathi.name: Jaysh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaysh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya is a Sanskrit word meaning victory or triumph. The name Jaysh is derived from Jaya and is used as a masculine name in Hindu tradition.
